summary: A number field with its unit (kg, %, km) as a suffix at the inline end of the box; accepts Arabic-Indic digits. A signal-model control of number | null: bind [(value)] or a signal-forms field.

inputs.name: value
inputs.description: The number; null when empty or unreadable; two-way [(value)].

inputs.name: unit
inputs.description: The unit text shown after the number (translated).

inputs.name: ariaLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name when there is no visible label (translated).

inputs.name: error
inputs.description: Error message (translated); a non-empty error marks the input invalid.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Native required plus a decorative asterisk.

inputs.name: invalid
inputs.description: Marks the input invalid without a message.

outputs.name: valueChange
outputs.description: The new number on every input (the model's change event).

outputs.name: touchedChange
outputs.description: Emits true on the first blur.

outputs.name: issueChange
outputs.description: The field's own problem when it changes: 'unreadable', 'below-min', 'above-max', or null.

a11y: A text input with inputmode decimal or numeric. The label is linked with for/id; the unit, hint and error are linked with aria-describedby (the unit first, so it is read with the value); an error, invalid or an own issue sets aria-invalid. The unit is the last flex item, so it sits on the inline end: right in LTR, left in RTL.
